column1: # The strict refusals a human reviewed against the CommonMark 0.31.2 spec text:
# case<TAB>subject<TAB>why the case genuinely exercises that construct.
# Only md:indented-code and md:lazy-continuation rows: a raw-HTML refusal is
# corroborated by the spec's own expected HTML instead. scripts/commonmark.lean
# fails a row whose case no longer raises its subject, and files a refusal with
# no row here as `owed` (uncorroborated), never as `rejected`.
# Reviewed 2026-09-25 against the spec text, with pandoc 3.11
# (-f commonmark+sourcepos) as a second opinion on where indented code sits;
# the tab-indented cases were checked by hand.
